title: About Me
description: Visual Effects Compositor with 10+ years of studio experience across feature films, commercials, and next-generation AI pipelines.
name: Prasannakumar T Bhat
info: For 10+ years, I've been weaving magic with pixels in the world of visual effects. It's thrilling to take raw footage, images, and 3D elements, and mold them into the final image that graces the big screen or TV. Seeing my work come to life is an unparalleled reward! I'm a relentless explorer, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible with the latest software in feature films, commercials, and TV projects. My passion for innovation extends beyond the screen. In my spare time, I delve into research, crafting tools and automating tasks with scripts. With deep expertise in compositing, I'm currently bringing my vision to life as a Compositing Artist at DNEG.
